Behaviour

The boss teleports and casts energy UE for up to 6k energy damage while the arena shields are up, it also casts a full-screen root, immobilizing all within the vicinity. Additionally it can break through magical defenses such as magic walls and wild growths.

Mitmah Vanguard attacks in melee range.

Strategy

Keep at a distance - Energy UE when close
